content: Deper Yarmat Mele Habe Hafle, Te Mekla Dipmi
Gich ika siya kkel irel tugulul ladep le, ila sibe tipingir irel yar weres ika ye tayikkel yar tugul ladep. Iwe ngo si towe foru chog ikla yebe fel lal depach iyang.
Bo semal gich ngo yebe hafle depel bisil bo yebe fel igegal bo hare yebe kkel loh tugulul ladep la yael mala bisil.
Bo Kristus ila yete kafelfelechog depal iy llufulyal. Babior we ye santus ye sor bo, “Hasong kala rechokla re sor wey iremi ila yesa bidah uwoy.”
Pangal meka ye teftaf lal babior we ye santus, ngo ye teftaf bo yebe hamdefagich bo hare gich yebe kkel depach irel mokwe Babior we ye Santus ye kangalgich.
Iwe ngo Deus le iy mele chapil lelayel repiy mo hakkelel ladep yebe hasewa chog yami teram irel yami dabey wegdeg kowe yael Kristus Jesus,
bo hare be pangamiloh ngo be sew chog yalomi irel yami hapingpinga Deus le Temal Samol we yach Jesus Kristus.
Sa Holar Gentiles Yalol Ebangelium We
Ila ha hafle fengalugmi bo fael falmay la yael Deus le be wochog yael iy Jesus forugmi bo habe fel mo irel.
Bo ibe kangalugmi le Kristus ila ye mel bo yar Jews boy bo yebe kawraloh le Deus ila ye katos irel mokwe ye hatugulu ngalir chaepdoh kowe bo yebe foru,
ngo hafforur Gentiles bo rebe hapingpinga Deus irel ffahol ladep la yal. Bo iwe babior we ye santus ye sor bo,

content.text: “Ibe kangalug yam hachigchig mo luwullur Gentiles,
ibe tona yai hapingping ngal mala idem.”
“Ha harraeyi lal dipmi hami Gentiles, ha daber meka lol Deus le yesa duwler!”
Ngo Isaiah ye wol sor bo,
“Semal chol daowe yael Jesse ila yebe budoh;
Deus yebe hatagitadah bo yebe lamlir Gentiles,
ngo ir rebe yetedah deper uwol.”

content: Deus le iy mele halpal ladep yebe fang ngalugmi rraey mo hopos irel tugulul ladep la yami irel. Bo hare yami yyalyal ila yebe tabtobloh chog yal kekkel loh irel mala kkelel Espritu Santus.
Fal Le Yela Kkel Yalol Babior We Tefayel Paulus
Rewol bisiy, ye luglug lal depey le hami ila ha ssogol momay ngo ha ssogol repiy, ngo ye yoh ngalugmi le habe hamdefa fengalugmi.
Iwe ngo irel babior le ngo isa halongol hawwel yai hapatpat irel tot formel we isa moal hamang ngalugmi. Sa wwel yai hapatpat le fael yengang kamdidiy le Deus yesa fang ngalyey,

bo ibela mel bo lol Kristus Jesus re hagloy ibe yengang ngalir Gentiles. Iy yengang le isa wochog semal temarong irel yai foloyu Hapatpat Momay le ye budoh mo irel Deus bo hare Gentiles ka le rebe wochog sew maligach le Espritu Santus yesa hasantusu ngo ye fel mo irel Deus.
Ila irel yai dabey Kristus Jesus ngo icchehas irel yengang ka yai ngal Deus.
Ibe hawwele yai hapatpat ngo ikapta chog mekla Kristus yesa tapeliyey iyang bo ibe wigdir gentiles bo rebe taelenga yalol Deus. Ye foru mele mo irel yal wegdeg mo hapatpat,

irel mela kkelel hagil mo mala kkemalal Espritu Santus le lamiliyel Deus. Le irel yai wegdeg mo hapatpat irel mekla kkelel hagil mo kkemal mo Espritu Santus. Be wigdir Gentiles bo rebe talenga yalol Deus. Ila irel yai malekah le ichuy mo Jerusalem isa loh Illyricum ngo ifoloyu pangal Hapatpat Momay we kofael Kristus.
Mala ngang iyeyedamgili, ila ibela foloyu Hapatpat Momay le mo lobokla yarmat reted rongrong kofael Kristus mo iyang. Ila ngo towe wochog molwe ifatlehadah woal sew dayif le semal mele ye fatleha.
Ila babior we ye santus ye sor bo,

content.text: “Rechokla rete kangalur kofal, ila rebe wiri,
ngo rechokla reted rongrong ila rebe medaf.”

content: Yael Paulus Luluwaley Bela Tefael Mo Roma
Ila fal le tema mmalloh yai buyoy iremi iyang.
Iwe ngo igla le isa hamallo yai yengang mo woal fuluka, ngo mele sa cholop raeg yai wedwedloh chog bo ibe buyoy tefael mwo mo iremi, ila
yesa cchang depey boy ibe buyoy igla. Idipli le ibe tefael mo iremi mo imol yodla ibe loh Spaeyyol, iwe ngo hami habe tipingyey bo hare wol miril yai mel tot iremi ngo ibe dohloh Spaeyyol.
Igla ila ibele loh mwo wol Jerusalem ibe hasiloh mala hammaler rechokwe lol Deus.
Bo eklesia ka wol Macedonia mo Greece ila sa ir chog yar hatugulu rebe fang sugfed salpiy bo hammaler rechokla re hafohoy mo luwullur mekla lol Deus mo woal Jerusalem.
Ir chog yar spegil hatugulu le rebe foru mele; ngo faesul yar yengang le rebe tipingir malhafohoy kala; bo hare Jews resa fang hammalel ngulur, ila ngo Gentiles rebe fang formel bo hammaler Jews.
Yodla be mol yai foru mele le isa fang ngalir pangal salpiy kowe re hateyili bo hammaler, ngo isa chuy ibe loh Spaeyyol ngo ibe hamowey tefael mwo mo iremi.
Igula le ibe buyoy tefael mo iremi ngo ye palleng yolbuw la Kristus yebe fang ngalugmi.
Ibe hafael pechehmi rewol bisiy le irel Samol we yach Jesus Kristus mo hachangcheng la Espritu Santus ye fang, ngo habe dabeyey sibe hakkela yach mapel ngal Deus bo yagliyey.
Ha mapel bo hare ibe daor mo lal payur rechokla tor yar tugulul ladep mo wol Judea, ngo hare yebe fel yai yengang ngalir mekla lol Deus mo wol Jerusalem.
Ila ibele buyoy iremi luwul yai rraey, bo hare ila mele depel Deus. Ibe rraey irel yai buyoy tefael mo iremi ngo ihasoso tot iremi.
Deus le iy mele yema fang ngalgich hopos yebe mel iremi. Amen.
